purpose: Frozen before any recomputation (11/03, after the review of bar_patterns.py). Defines the mention categories used to split each slide-5 bar exactly, and, for each coded clause option, the error type the clause's wording predicts. The script asserts this file's SHA-256.

categories.order_note: first matching rule wins, in the order listed per label
Modifier: gold text is exactly cancer(s) or tumo(u)r(s)
gold text contains ' and ', ' or ' or ' / '
M full name before gene/protein noun

member of the 99 gene/protein-noun Modifier gold (modifier_subset.py B1, molecular head) whose text contains a lower-case word of 4+ letters, i.e. a written-out disease name rather than an abbreviation
SpecificDisease: only ',', 'and', 'or', '/', 'and / or' between it and another gold mention
2+ tokens, last token cancer/carcinoma/tumo(u)r/neoplasm/lymphoma/sarcoma/hamartoma/adenoma/melanoma/glioma/leuk(a)emia/blastoma, singular or plural
DiseaseClass: gold text is exactly cancer(s) or tumo(u)r(s)

head word (the word before the first ' of ' if any, else the last word) is a disease or category noun (disease, disorder, syndrome, condition, defect, malformation, cancer, tumo(u)r, carcinoma, neoplasm, neoplasia, dysplasia, dystrophy, infection, singular or plural) or ends in -itis, -pathy, -plegia, -osis, -oma(s)
remaining DiseaseClass gold that is coordinated with another gold mention

predicted_error_types.Q1 relational nouns -> Modifier: non-Modifier gold after a relational noun labelled Modifier (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q1 relational nouns -> not Modifier: same count, not expected to rise
predicted_error_types.Q2 site word not enough: Specific gold of the tumour-word category labelled DiseaseClass (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q2 site word enough: same count, not expected to rise
predicted_error_types.Q3 separate unless shared head: Specific or DiseaseClass gold coordinated with another gold, labelled Composite or left unpaired (count falls)
predicted_error_types.Q4 signs/states -> DiseaseClass: DiseaseClass gold of the two sign/state categories labelled right (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q4 exception: not annotated or sent to r: DiseaseClass gold of the two sign/state categories missed (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q5 bare cancer/tumor not annotated or fl: bare cancer/tumor gold, DiseaseClass or Modifier, missed (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q6 official gene names not annotated: Modifier gold of the full-name gene/protein category missed (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q6 Modifier including official names: Modifier gold of the full-name gene/protein category labelled right (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q8a deficient adjective -> Modifier: Modifier gold of the deficient-adjective category labelled right (count rises)
predicted_error_types.Q8b coordinated names as modifier -> Mod: Modifier gold of the coordinated-names category labelled right (count rises)

evidence_rule: A clause is credited with a change only if at least two of three hold: (1) the category part of the bar lies outside the 19 original runs' range for that category; (2) the predicted error type moved in the predicted direction outside its original range; (3) among the guideline's changed predictions in that category, the annotator's cited section names the section that holds the clause (any position in the citation). Missed mentions have no rationale, so (3) cannot hold for them.
controls: For a guideline whose clauses predict losses in one DiseaseClass category, the DiseaseClass categories its clauses do not govern are reported beside it; if they fall outside range too, the clause effect and a general decline are not separable.
